summary: Iter 21 (OG image + Salon Profile editor + Reminders widget + Top Referrers leaderboard) fully verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASS — (a) GET /api/settings/branding returns the full {name, slug, google_review_url, hours, phone, location, hero_image} shape; PUT persists the values (verified by next GET); PUT with google_review_url='not-a-url' returns 422 from BrandingIn field_validator. (b) GET /api/dashboard/reminders returns {count, items[]} with each item carrying appointment_id, customer_name, customer_phone, scheduled_at, staff_name, service_names[], reminded:false. POST /mark-sent flips reminded=true (or filters the row out); POST with a bogus id returns 404. (c) GET /api/super-admin/affiliates/leaderboard with super_admin token returns {items[], reward_per_signup:1000}, items sorted by affiliate_credits desc — empty currently (no referrals yet). The same endpoint with regular admin token returns 403. (d) Static assets: /og-image.png is 642 KB image/png; /favicon.svg is 200 image/svg+xml; /manifest.json is 200 JSON containing 'Miracurl'. Public / HTML contains the 'Miracurl ✦ Salon Suite' title, og:image, og:title, og:description, twitter:card='summary_large_image', and link rel=icon to /favicon.svg. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): salon-admin login → /settings shows settings-branding-card BEFORE the Tax/GST card with all 5 inputs (settings-google-review-url, settings-hours, settings-phone, settings-location, settings-hero-image) + settings-save-branding-btn; editing google_review_url, saving, reloading → value persists. Dashboard reminders-widget hidden when no upcoming bookings (verified) and visible with a reminder-row-<aid> + reminder-send-<aid> button when an appt status='booked' is created within next 24h with a customer that has a phone; clicking reminder-send opens api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=…&text=… in a new tab AND removes the row from the widget (POST /mark-sent confirmed). Super-admin login → /super-admin shows the new 'Top Referrers' tab (super-tab-leaderboard) next to Tenants and Billing & Subscriptions; clicking it renders leaderboard-panel and currently shows leaderboard-empty with the 'No referrals yet · ₹1,000 per signup' CTA. Test appt and TEST_-prefixed customer cleaned up; branding google_review_url reset back to the default Miracurl Google link from .env.

minor.issue: Status semantics mismatch: Appointment model defaults status='scheduled' (and public booking + POST /api/appointments both leave it as 'scheduled'), but /api/dashboard/reminders filters by status in {'booked','confirmed'}. Real-world appointments created today will therefore NEVER appear in the reminders widget unless someone manually flips the status via PUT /api/appointments/{id}/status → 'booked'. Either widen the reminders filter to include 'scheduled' OR change the default status to 'booked' OR add 'scheduled' to the allowed set. Reproduced: POST /api/appointments with scheduled_at = now+6h → row absent from /reminders; PUT status='booked' → row appears. Verified in playwright as well — widget only showed up after the status bump.

issues: Recharts container emits 4 console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first paint of the Trend Line / Top Services panels — cosmetic only, charts still render correctly once layout settles. Suggest wrapping ResponsiveContainer in a parent with explicit minHeight or defer mounting until container has size.

action_items: FIX (minor but functionally important): align appointment status vocab with the reminders filter — either add 'scheduled' to the {booked,confirmed} set in GET /api/dashboard/reminders (line ~1582 of server.py) OR change the default status in the Appointment model from 'scheduled' to 'booked' OR have POST /api/public/book set status='booked' explicitly. Without this fix, the WhatsApp reminders widget will sit empty even when bookings exist.
OPTIONAL polish: silence the 4 recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings on Dashboard first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py BrandingIn (L1535-1550): field_validator on google_review_url correctly rejects strings that don't start with http(s):// → 422. Accepts http:// as well as https:// (per the request the validator was supposed to require https:// — currently http:// also slips through). Minor — recommend tightening to https:// only since marketing copy says 'short link from Google Business Profile' which is always https.

server.py update_branding (L1567-1572): uses exclude_none=True so sending {google_review_url:''} (empty string) WILL persist an empty string (the validator returns '' for None/empty). Good — that matches the 'clear my field' UX.

server.py upcoming_reminders (L1575-1610): tenant scoping is automatic via the TenantCollection proxy + contextvars (verified — only the calling admin's appts come back). The status filter is the only functional issue (see backend_issues.minor). Otherwise correct: 26h horizon, only customers with phone, reminded flag derived from reminder_sent_at.
server.py mark_reminder_sent (L1613-1622): bumps reminder_sent_at and returns 404 cleanly when the appt isn't in the current tenant. Good.

server.py affiliate_leaderboard (L1625-1643): uses MongoDB aggregate to fetch referral_count in one query — efficient. Excludes _id, casts affiliate_credits to float, exposes reward_per_signup constant. ACL via require_super_admin → admin token gets 403. Good.

Settings.jsx (L79-161): branding card placed BEFORE Tax/GST card as requested. All 6 testids present. UX: 'Save profile' button has separate savingBrand state so it doesn't fight with the Tax save button. Toast on success/failure wired to axios response. Reload-and-persist verified.

Dashboard.jsx RemindersWidget (L297+): correctly conditionally rendered (no widget when items array is empty). Each row has data-testid reminder-row-<id> and reminder-send-<id>. Clicking the send button opens a wa.me / api.whatsapp.com URL in a new tab AND fires the /mark-sent POST in parallel — verified row disappears after.

SuperAdmin.jsx (L118 tab + L287 panel + L299 empty): clean 3-tab layout. Empty state copy 'No referrals yet · Once your salons share their ?ref= links … they'll appear here ranked by total credits earned.' is clear.

public/index.html: full OG + Twitter + Apple touch + manifest tags wired. og:image points at https://miracurlunisexsaloon.com/og-image.png (production CDN as intended), favicon.svg + manifest.json served correctly by the preview proxy too.

Minor consistency nit: /api/dashboard/reminders uses get_current_user (not require_tenant_admin) — a non-admin tenant user could call it. Not a security issue (data is still tenant-scoped) but worth tightening to admin if the widget is admin-only.

rca of the issue: Reminders widget empty-state RCA: Appointment.status defaults to 'scheduled' in server.py L405 and neither POST /api/appointments (L811) nor POST /api/public/book (via _create_public_appointment L1345) overrides this. But upcoming_reminders (L1582) filters status ∈ {'booked','confirmed'}. So no real-world appointment ever reaches the reminders endpoint without an explicit PUT /api/appointments/{id}/status. Reproduction: POST a future appointment → GET /reminders → empty; PUT status='booked' → row appears. Mitigation (one of): (1) add 'scheduled' to the $in list in L1582, (2) change Appointment.status default to 'booked' on L405, or (3) have _create_public_appointment set status='booked' explicitly. Option (1) is the safest/non-breaking fix.
